venge.definition: v. t. To avenge; to punish; to revenge.
venge.translation: vt. 为……报仇, 替……复仇[古]

vengeance.definition: n. the act of taking revenge (harming someone in retaliation for something harmful that they have done) especially in the next life; I will repay, saith the Lord"--Romans 12:19
vengeance.translation:
n. 复仇, 报仇
[法] 报仇, 复仇

vengeful.definition: s disposed to seek revenge or intended for revenge
vengeful.translation: a. 复仇心重的, 报复的

vengefully.definition: r in a vindictive, revengeful manner

vengefulness.definition: n a malevolent desire for revenge
